3.1.1.e: Everything told in this अधिकार are known as प्रत्ययाः.

3.1.2.e: All the words told in this अधिकार are to be attached at the end of the प्रकृति.

3.1.3.e: The first स्वर of all the प्रत्ययाः mentioned in this अधिकार becomes उदात्त.

3.1.4.e: The first letter of the सुप् and the पित् प्रत्ययाः is अनुदात्त.

3.1.5.e: After the verbs गुप् , तिज् and कित् comes the affix सन्।

3.1.6.e: The affix सन् comes after the verbs मान 'to honour', बध् 'to bind', दान् 'to cut', and शान् 'to whet', and long ई is the substitute of इ -- सन्यतः [[7.4.79]] of the re-duplicate -- पूर्वोऽभ्यासः [[6.1.4]] syllable.

3.1.7.e: The affix is optionally attached, in the sense of 'wishing' after a root expressing the object wished and having the same agent of the action as the wisher thereof.

3.1.8.e: The affix क्यच् is optionally employed, in the sense of wishing after a word ending in a case-affix expressing the object wished as connected with the wisher itself.

3.1.9.e: And the affix काम्यच् is also used in the sense of 'wishing' after a word ending in a case-affix, expressing the object wished as connected with the wisher's self.

3.1.10.e: The affix क्यच् is optionally employed, in the sense of treatment after a word ending in a case-affix denoting the object of comparison.

3.1.11.e: The affix क्यङ् is optionally used in the sense of 'behaving' after a word ending in a case-affix denoting the object of comparison of the agent and there is लोप (elision) of the final स of the noun if it ends in a स।

3.1.12.e: The affix क्यङ् in the sense of becoming what the thing previously was not, is used after the crude forms भृश् etc. which do not end with the affix च्वि -- अभूततद्भावे कृभ्वस्तियोगे सम्पद्यकर्तरि च्विः [[5.4.50]], and there is लोप (elision) of the final consonant of these words, if they end in a consonant.

3.1.13.e: The affix क्यष् in the sense of becoming what the thing previously was not, is used after the words लोहित etc. and after those that end with the affix डाच् -- अव्यक्तानुकरणाद्द्व्यजवरार्धादनितौ डाच् [[5.4.57]], when these words do not take the affix च्वि -- अव्यक्तानुकरणाद्द्व्यजवरार्धादनितौ डाच् [[5.4.57]].

3.1.14.e: The affix क्यङ् in the sense of exerting in the dishonesty, is employed after the word कष्ट 'mischief' when the latter has the 4th case-affix in construction.

3.1.15.e: The affix क्यङ् is used after the words रोमन्य 'ruminating' and तपस 'austerity', when they are used as the objects of the action of repeating and performing respectively.

3.1.16.e: The affix क्यङ् is used in the sense of ejecting after the words वाष्प 'vapour' and ऊष्म 'heat' as the object of the action.

3.1.17.e: The affix क्यङ् , in the sense of 'making', comes after these words, as the object of the action, viz. शब्द 'sound', वैर 'hostility', कलह 'strife', अभ्र 'cloud', कण्व 'sin' and मेध 'cloud'.

3.1.18.e: The affix क्यङ् in the sense of 'feeling', comes after the words सुख 'pleasure' etc. when the pleasure etc. belong to the agent as feels thereof.

3.1.19.e: The affix in the sense of 'making', comes after these words, as the object of the action, viz. नमस् 'adoration', वरिवस् 'honour', चित्र 'wonder'.

3.1.20.e: The affix णिङ् , in the sense of making, comes after these words as the object of the action, viz. पुच्छ 'tail', भाण्ड 'pot' and चीवर 'rag'.

3.1.21.e: The affix णिच् , in the sense of 'making' comes after these words as the object of action viz. मुण्ड 'shaving', मिश्र 'mixture', श्लक्ष्ण 'soft', लवण 'salt', व्रत 'vow', वस्त्र 'dress', हल 'plough', कल 'strife', कृत 'done' and तूस्त 'matter hair'.

3.1.22.e: The affix वङ् , in the sense of repetition of the act, comes after a root, having a single vowel and beginning with a consonant.

3.1.23.e: The affix वङ् invariably comes in the sense of 'crookedness' after a simple verb expressing motion.

3.1.24.e: The affix वङ् when it is intended to convey the sense of contempt (गर्हा) in respect of the sense of the root (भाव) comes always after the following roots - लुप् 'to cut off', सद् 'to sit', चर् 'to walk', जप् 'to mutter silently any sacred formula', जभ 'to gape or yawn', दह् 'to burn', दश् 'to bite' and गृ 'to swallow'.

3.1.25.e: The affix णिच् is used after these words - सत्य 'truth' (which then takes the form of सत्याप as exhibited in the sūtra), पाश 'a fetter', रूप 'form', वीणा 'a lute', तूल 'cotton', श्लोक 'celebration', सेना 'army', लोम 'the hair of the body', त्वच 'skin', वर्म 'mail', वर्ण 'celebration', चूर्ण 'powder' and the verb of the चुरादि class.

3.1.26.e: The affix णिच् is used after a root, when the operation of a causer is to be expressed.

3.1.27.e: The affix यक् is used after the roots कण्डु 'to itch' etc.

3.1.28.e: The affix आय comes after गुपू 'to protect', धूप 'to heat', विच्छ 'to approach', पण 'to contract or praise' and पन 'to praise'.

3.1.29.e: The affix ईयङ् comes after the sūtra root ऋति 'to reproach'.

3.1.30.e: The affix णिङ् comes after the root कम 'to desire'.

3.1.31.e: The affixes आय and those that follow it i.e. आय , ईयङ् and णिङ् are optionally added, when it is desired to express one's self with an आर्धधातुक affix.

3.1.32.e: The words ending in a सनादि प्रत्यय are called 'धातु'.

3.1.33.e: In case of लृट् लकार and  लृङ्लकार, the अङ्ग gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'स्य'. In case of  लुट्लकार, the अङ्ग gets the विकरणप्रत्यय तास्.

3.1.34.e: सिप् is diversely the affix of a verbal root when लेट् follows.

3.1.35.e: आम् is the affix of the verb कास् 'to cough' and of those roots that are formed by affixes i.e. the derivative verbs, when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows, in the मन्त्र।

3.1.36.a: इजादेः गुरुमतः अनृच्छः धातोः लिटि आम् प्रत्ययः परश्च
3.1.36.e: A verb which can be called as 'इजादिः गुरुमान्' gets an आम् प्रत्यय when followed by लिट्-लकार. However, this प्रत्यय is not seen for the verb root ऋच्छ्.

3.1.37.e: After the words दय 'to give', 'to go' and 'to protect', अय 'to go' and आस 'to sit', there is the affix आम् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

3.1.38.e: The affix आम् is optionally used after these - उष् 'to burn', विद् 'to know' and जागृ 'to wake', when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

3.1.39.e: आम् is optionally affixed when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows after these verbs - भी 'to fear', ह्री 'to be ashamed', भृ 'to nourish', हु 'to sacrifice' and when आम् is affixed, the effect is as if there were श्लु elision and the roots belonged to ह्वादि class.

3.1.40.e: The लिट्-लकार forms of verb roots कृ, भू, and अस् are applied after the आम्-प्रत्यय.

3.1.41.e: The form विदाङ्कुर्वन्तु is optionally employed as an irregular form.

3.1.42.e: The forms अभ्युत्सादयामकः प्रजनयामकः चिकयामकः रमयामकः पावयांक्रियाद् विदामक्रन् are irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.1.43.e: In case of लुङ्लकार, धातु gets the च्लि विकरणप्रत्यय.

3.1.44.e: The च्लि विकरण is converted to सिच्.

3.1.45.e: The च्लि प्रत्यय that follows a शल्-वर्णान्त, इगुपध and अनिट्-धातु is converted to 'क्स.

3.1.46.e: When used with the meaning of 'giving a hug', The च्लि-प्रत्यय that follows the verb root श्लिष् is converted to क्स.

3.1.47.e: For the verb root दृश्, च्लि is not converted to क्स.

3.1.48.e: For the verbs ending in णि-प्रत्यय, and for the verbs  श्रि, द्रु and स्रु, the  च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to चङ् in the  कर्तरि context.

3.1.49.e: For the verbs धेट् and श्वि , the च्लि प्रत्यय is optionally converted to चङ्.

3.1.50.e: After the verb गुप् 'to protect', चङ् is optionally the substitute of च्लि in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.1.51.e: After the causatives of the verbs ऊन 'to decrease', ध्वन 'to sound', इल् 'to send' and अर्द 'to go or to beg' चङ् is not the substitute of च्लि in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.1.52.e: For the verbs असुँ (क्षेपणे), वच्, and ख्या, the च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to अङ्.

3.1.53.e: For the verb roots लिप् , सिच् and ह्वे , the च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to अङ्.

3.1.54.e: For the verb roots लिप् , सिच् and ह्वे , the च्लि-प्रत्यय is optionally converted to अङ् when followed by a प्रत्यय of आत्मनेपद.

3.1.55.e: For the verbs of पुषादिगण and द्युतादिगण, as well as for the ऌदित verbs, च्लि is converted to अङ् when followed by a प्रत्यय of परस्मैपद.

3.1.56.e: For the verbs सृ, शास् and ऋ, the च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to अङ्.

3.1.57.e: For the इरित्-verbs, the च्लि प्रत्यय is optionally converted to अङ्.

3.1.58.e: For the verbs जॄ, स्तन्भ्, म्रुच्, म्लुच्, ग्रुच्, ग्लुच्, ग्लुञ्च्,  टुओश्वि - the  च्लि-प्रत्यय is  optionally converted to  अङ्.

3.1.59.e: After the words कृ 'to do', मृ 'to die', दॄ (9P) 'to tear' and रुह 'to rise', अङ् is the substitute of च्लि when used in छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.1.60.e: चिण् is the substitute of च्लि after the verb पद् 'to go' when the affix त follows.

3.1.61.e: चिण् is optionally the substitute of च्लि , when त - 3rd Person Singular of आत्मनेपद follows after the verbs दीप् 'to shine', जन् 'to be produced', बुध् 'to teach or know', पूर् 'to be full', ताय् 'to extend or protect' and प्याय 'to smell'.

3.1.62.e: चिण् is optionally the substitute of च्लि , when त - 3rd Person Singular of आत्मनेपद follows after a root which ends with a vowel and when the object itself is spoken of as the agent.

3.1.63.e: चिण् is optionally the substitute of च्लि after the verb दुह् 'to milk', when it is used reflexively and when त follows.

3.1.64.e: चिण् is not the substitute of च्लि after the verb रुध् 'to obstruct' when used in the reflexive sense in the 3rd Person Singular of आत्मनेपद ।

3.1.65.e: चिण् is not the substitute of च्लि after the verb तप् 'to suffer' when used reflexively and when the sense of experiencing remorse.

3.1.66.e: चिण् is the substitute of च्लि when त -3rd Person Singular आत्मनेपद follows, denoting the action (भाव) or the object कर्म्म।

3.1.67.e: In the कर्मणि and the प्रयोगे भावे प्रयोग, धातु gets 'यक्' प्रत्यय when followed by a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय.

3.1.68.e: A verb gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'शप्' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.

3.1.69.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके दिवादिभ्यः धातोः परः श्यन् प्रत्ययः
3.1.69.e: A verb belonging to the दिवादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'श्यन्' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.

3.1.70.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके भ्राश-भ्लाश-भ्रमु-क्रमु-क्लमु-त्रसि-त्रुटि-लषः धातोः परः श्यन् वा
3.1.70.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verbs भ्राश् , भ्लाश्, भ्रम्, क्रम्, क्लम्, त्रस्, त्रुट्, लष्  get the  श्यन् विकरण optionally.

3.1.71.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके अनुपसर्गात् यसः धातोः परः श्यन् वा
3.1.71.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verb  यस् when used without an उपसर्ग gets the श्यन् विकरण optionally.

3.1.72.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके संयसः धातोः परः श्यन् वा
3.1.72.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verb यस् when used with the उपसर्ग 'सम्' gets the श्यन् विकरण optionally.

3.1.73.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके स्वादिभ्यः धातोः परः श्नुः प्रत्ययः
3.1.73.e: A verb belonging to the स्वादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'श्नु' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.

3.1.74.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके श्रुवः धातोः परः श्नुः प्रत्ययः, शृः च
3.1.74.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verb श्रु is converted to शृ and it gets the श्नु विकरणप्रत्यय.

3.1.75.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verb अक्ष्  gets the श्नु विकरण optionally.

3.1.76.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके तनूकरणे तक्षः श्नुः अन्यतरस्याम्
3.1.76.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verb तक्ष्  with the meaning 'to peel off / to scrape off' gets the श्नु विकरण optionally.

3.1.77.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके तुदादिभ्यः धातोः परः श-प्रत्ययः
3.1.77.e: A verb belonging to the तुदादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'श' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.

3.1.78.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके रुधादिभ्यः धातोः परः श्नम्-प्रत्ययः
3.1.78.e: A verb belonging to the रुधादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'श्नम्' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.

3.1.79.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके तनादिकृञ्भ्यः धातोः परः उ-प्रत्ययः
3.1.79.e: A verb belonging to the तनादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'उ' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.

3.1.80.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके धिन्वि-कृण्व्योः उः अः च
3.1.80.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verbs धिन्व्, कृण्व् gets the 'उ' विकरणप्रत्यय.

3.1.81.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके क्र्यादिभ्यः धातोः परः श्ना-प्रत्ययः
3.1.81.e: A verb belonging to the क्र्यादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'श्ना' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.

3.1.82.a: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके स्तन्भुँ-स्तुन्भुँ-स्कन्भुँ-स्कुन्भुँ-स्कुञ्भ्यः धातोः परः श्नुः श्ना च
3.1.82.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verbs  स्तम्भ्, स्तुम्भ्, स्कम्भ्, स्कुम्भ्, स्कुञ् gets the श्ना or the श्नु विकरणप्रत्यय.

3.1.83.e: The श्ना प्रत्यय following a हल् letter is converted to शानच् when followed by the 'हि' प्रत्यय.

3.1.84.a: छन्दसि श्नः हौ शानच् शायज् अपि
3.1.84.e: The श्ना प्रत्यय following a हल् letter is seen converted either to शायच् or शानच् when followed by the 'हि' प्रत्यय.

3.1.85.e: In the context of वेदाः - Some kind of irregularity might be seen with reference to application of विकरणप्रत्ययाः

3.1.86.a: छन्दसि आशिषि लिङि धातोः परः अङ् अपि कर्तरि सार्वधातुके
3.1.86.e: In the context of वेदाः - The सार्वधातुक forms of आशीर्लिङ्गलकार can also use अङ् as गणविकरणप्रत्यय.

3.1.87.e: The ल denoting the agent, when the action affecting the agent is similar to the action which affects the object, is treated as if it were a ल denoting the object.

3.1.88.e: The agent of the verb तप् 'to heat', becomes similar to the object, only when the object is the word तपस् itself.

3.1.89.e: The affix यक् -- सार्वधातुके यक् [[3.1.67]],and चिण् -- अचः कर्मकर्तरि [[3.1.62]] are not used in the reflexive voice of the verbs दुह् 'to milk', स्नु 'to fall in drops' and नम् 'to bow.

3.1.90.e: The affix श्यन् comes after the roots कुष् 'to pull' and रञ्ज 'to colour' in the reflexive voice, according to the opinion of Eastern Grammarians and these verbs take the affixes of परस्मैपद ।

3.1.91.e: As far as the end of the Third Chapter reckoning from the present sūtra, the affixes treated of are to be understood as coming after some verbal root. (Note: This is an अधिकार सूत्र। All these verbal affixes are broadly classified as कृत् and कृत्य affixes)

3.1.92.e: The words referenced by the सप्तमीस्थ words of the sutras in this धात्वधिकार get the term 'उपपद'.

3.1.93.e: In this portion of the sūtras in which there is a reference to verbal roots, any affix except तिङ् - tense affixes, is called कृत् ।

3.1.94.e: In this portion of the sūtras, in which there is reference to verbal roots, an affix which is calculated to debar a general one, not being of the same form, optionally debars it; but not so in the case of feminine affixes -- स्त्रियां क्तिन् [[3.3.94]].

3.1.95.e: From this sūtra up to ण्वुल्तृचौ [[3.1.133]] all the affixes treated will get the name कृत्य।

3.1.96.e: The affixes तव्यत् , तव्य and अनीयर् come after the verbal roots.

3.1.97.e: The affix यत् comes after a root that ends in a vowel.

3.1.98.e: The affix यत् comes after a root which ends in a labial letter preceded by a short अ।

3.1.99.e: The affix यत् comes after roots शकॢ 'to be able' and सह 'to bear'.

3.1.100.e: The affix यत् comes after roots गद् 'to eat', मद् 'to be mad', चर् 'to go, to eat' and यम् 'to restrain', when these roots do not take any preposition.

3.1.101.e: The words अवद्य , पण्य , वर्या are irregularly formed, having the sense of 'condemnable', saleable' and unobstructable', respectively.

3.1.102.e: The word वह्यं is irregularly formed when the meaning of the word is an instrument of carrying.

3.1.103.e: The word अर्य is irregularly formed when meaning 'lord' and a वैश्य।

3.1.104.e: The word उपसर्या is irregularly formed when meaning what has reached the time favourable to conception or ripe for fruition.

3.1.105.e: The word अजर्यंम् 'imperishable' is irregularly formed when qualifying the word संगतम् 'friendship' expressed or understood.

3.1.106.e: After the root वद् 'to speak', governing a case-inflected word as its उपपद and not having a preposition annexed to it, there comes the affix क्यप् also.

3.1.107.e: After the root भू 'to be', in construction with a case-inflected word as its उपपद and when used without a preposition, the affix क्यप् is used to denote condition - भाव।

3.1.108.e: After the root हनु 'to kill' when in construction with a case-inflected word as its उपपद and when used without a preposition comes the affix क्यप् in denoting condition and the letter त is the substitute of its final.

3.1.109.e: After the verbs इ 'to go', स्तु 'to praise', शास् 'to govern', वृ 'to respect' and जुष् 'to please' comes the affix क्यप्।

3.1.110.e: After the verbs having the penultimate short ऋ , the affix क्यप् is used, with the exception of the verbs कॢप् 'to be able' and वृत् 'to hurt'.

3.1.111.e: The affix क्यप् is used after the root खन 'to dig' and long ई is substituted for the final of the root.

3.1.112.e: The affix क्यप् is used after the root भृञ् 'to bear' when not used as a name.

3.1.113.e: The affix क्यप् is optionally used after the verb सृज् 'to cleanse'.

3.1.114.e: The words राजसूय , सूर्य , मृषोद्य , रुच्य , कुप्य , कृष्ट , पच्य and अव्यथ्य irregularly formed by the addition of the affix क्यप्।

3.1.115.e: The words भिद्य and उद्ध्यौ are irregularly formed by the affix क्यप् , when meaning 'river'.

3.1.116.e: The words पुष्य and सिद्ध्य् are irregularly formed by the affix क्यप् , when used as names of asterisms.

3.1.117.e: When the words विपूय , विनीय and जित्या are irregularly formed they mean 'the मुञ्ज grass', 'the sediment' and 'the plough', respectively.

3.1.118.e: The word ग्रह 'to seize', preceded by the prepositions प्रति and अपि , takes the affix क्यप् in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.1.119.e: The root ग्रह 'to seize' takes the affix क्यप् when it means a 'word', a 'dependent', 'outside' or a 'partisan'.

3.1.120.e: After the verbs कृञ् 'to do' and वृष् 'to rain', the affix क्यप् is optionally used.

3.1.121.e: The word युग्यम् is irregularly formed meaning 'a vehicle'.

3.1.122.e: Optionally the word अमावस्या is irregular.

3.1.123.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the following words are found, which are formed irregularly - निष्टर्क्य , देवहूय , प्रणीय , उन्नीय , उच्छिष्य , मर्य , स्तर्या , ध्वर्य , खन्य , खान्य , देवयज्या , आपृच्छ्य , प्रतिषीव्य , ब्रह्मवाद्य , भाव्य , स्ताव्य , and पचाय्यपृड।

3.1.124.e: The affix ण्यत् comes after a verb that ends in ऋ (long or short) or in a consonant.

3.1.125.e: The affix ण्यत् comes after a verb that ends in the letter उ - long or short, when the sense is that of 'necessity'.

3.1.126.e: The affix ण्यत् comes after the verbs आसु 'to distill', यु 'to join', वप 'to sow', रप् 'to speak distinctly', लप् 'to prate', अप् 'to be ashamed' and चम 'to drink'.

3.1.127.e: The word आनाय्यः is irregularly formed when meaning 'impermanent'.

3.1.128.e: The word प्रणाय्य is irregularly formed when meaning 'disapproved'.

3.1.129.e: The words पाय्य , सान्नाय्य , निकाय्य and धाय्या are irregularly formed meaning 'a measure', 'an oblation to fire', 'a dwelling' and 'a sacrificial prayer', respectively.

3.1.130.e: The words कुण्डपाय्यः and संचाय्यः are irregularly formed meaning 'a sacrifice'.

3.1.131.e: The words परिचाय्यः , पचाय्य and समूह्याः are irregularly formed when they are names of fire.

3.1.132.e: The words चित्य and ग्निचित्य are also irregularly formed.

3.1.133.e: The affixes ण्वुल् (अक्) and तृच् (तृ) are placed after all verbal roots, expressing the agent.

3.1.134.e: After the verbs classed as नन्द 'to be happy', ग्रह 'to take' and पच् 'to cook' there are the affixes ल्यु (अन), णिनि (इन्) and अच (अ) respectively.

3.1.135.e: After a verb ending in a consonant but preceded by इ , उ or ऋ -long or short, and after the verbs ज्ञा 'to know', श्री 'to please' and कॄ 'to scatter', comes the affix क (अ)।

3.1.136.e: Also after a verb ending in long आ when there is a preposition along with it, the affix क is placed.

3.1.137.e: The affix श (अ) is used after the roots पा 'to drink', घ्रा 'to smell', ध्मा 'to blow' and धेट् 'to suck' and दृश् 'to see' when there is a preposition along with these roots.

3.1.138.e: The affix श is used after the verbs - धारि , पारि , वेदि , उदेजि , चेति , साति and साहि , when used without a preposition.

3.1.139.e: The affix श is optionally used after the root दा 'to give' and धा 'to hold', when used without a preposition.

3.1.140.e: After the verbs beginning with ज्वल 'to shine' and ending with कस 'to go', when used without a preposition, the affix ण is optionally used.

3.1.141.e: The affix ण is also used after the verbs - श्यै 'to go', verbs ending in a long भा , व्यद् 'to pierce', आस्रु 'to pain', संत्रु 'to flow', अतीण् 'to pass on', अवसा 'to complete', अवह 'to take away', लिह 'to lick', श्लिष 'to embrace' and श्वस 'to breathe'.

3.1.142.e: The affix ण is used after the verbs दु 'to burn' and नी 'to lead', when used without a preposition.

3.1.143.e: The affix ण is optionally used after the verb ग्रह 'to seize'.

3.1.144.e: The affix क is used after the verb ग्रह 'to seize' when the agent so expressed denotes a house.

3.1.145.e: The affix ष्वुन् (अक्) comes after a verb when the agent so expressed denotes an artist.

3.1.146.e: The affix थकन् (थक) comes after the verb गै 'to sing' when the agent so expressed, denotes an artist.

3.1.147.e: The affix ण्युट् is also used after the verb गै 'to sing' when the agent so expressed denotes an artist.

3.1.148.e: After the verb हा , also the affix ण्युट् is used when the agent so expressed denotes 'rice' and 'time'.

3.1.149.e: After the verbs प्रु 'to go', सृ 'to move', स्रु 'to flow' and लू 'to cut', the affix वुन् is used, when repitition is meant.

3.1.150.e: The affix वुन् is applied after all verbs when Benediction is intended.

3.2.1.e: The affix अण् comes after a verbal root when the object (or whatever sort it may be), is in composition with it (an an उपपद).

3.2.2.e: The affix अण् comes after a root हूञ् 'to call' वेञ् 'to weave', माङ् 'to measure', when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.3.e: The affix क comes after a verbal root that ends in long आ when there is no उपसर्ग preceding it and when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.4.e: The affix क comes after the root स्था when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix, as an उपपद ।

3.2.5.e: The affix क comes after the verbs परिमृज् 'to wash out' and अपनुद् 'to drive away' when in composition with the words तुन्द 'navel' and शोक 'grief', as objects respectively.

3.2.6.e: The affix क comes after the root दा 'to give' and ज्ञ 'to know', when taking the preposition प्र in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.7.e: The affix क comes after root ख्या 'to tell', when preceded by the preposition सम् and when the object is in compsition with it.

3.2.8.e: The affix टक comes after the verbs गै 'to sing' and पा 'to drink' when used without a preposition and when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.9.e: The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् when it does not mean 'to raise up', when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.10.e: The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् when the object is in composition with it and when the meaning of the word to be formed is descriptive of age.

3.2.11.e: The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् (when the object is in composition with it) the root taking the preposition आञ् and the sense of the word to be formed in inclination or accustomed occupation.

3.2.12.e: The affix अच् comes after the verb अर्ह 'to respect', when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.13.e: The affix अच् comes after the verb रम् 'to sport' and जप् 'to whisper' when the case-inflected words स्तम्भ 'a clump of grass' and कर्ण 'ear' are in composition with them respectively.

3.2.14.e: The affix अच् is used after the verbal roots when शम् 'well' is in composition and the word to be formed denotes a name.

3.2.15.e: The affix अच् comes after the verb शी 'to lie down' when in composition with a case-inflected word indicating location i.e. in the Locative -7th-case.

3.2.16.e: The affix ट comes after the verb चर् 'to go' when a case-inflected word in composition with it denotes a location.

3.2.17.e: The affix ट is used after the verb चर् 'to go' when the words in composition with it भिक्षा 'alms', सेना 'army' and आदाय 'having taken'.

3.2.18.e: The affix ट comes after the verb सृ 'to move' when the words in composition with it are पुरः , अग्रतः and अग्रे , all meaning 'in front or before'.

3.2.19.e: The affix ट comes after the verb सृ 'to go' when पूर्व in composition with it, denoting the agent.

3.2.20.e: The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the object is in composition with it denoting cause, habit and going with the grain (concession).

3.2.21.e: The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the following words are in composition with it - 1. दिवा 'by day' 2. विभा 'light' 3. निशा 'night' 4. प्रभा 'splendour' 5. भाः 'light' 6. कार 'work' 7. अन्त 'end' 8. अनन्त 'endless' 9. आदि 'beginning' 10. बहु 'many' 11. नान्दी 'benediction' 12. किम् 'what' 13. लिपि 'writing' 14. लिबि 'writing' 15. बलि 'oblation' 16. भक्ति 'devotion' 17. कर्तृ 'agent' 18. चित्र 'painting' 19. क्षेत्र 'field' 20. संख्या - words denoting numerals 21. जङ्घा 'thigh' 22. बाहु 'hand' 23. अहः 'day' 24. यत् 'what' 25. तत् 'that' 26. धनुस् 'bow' 27. अरुस् 'wound'.

3.2.22.e: The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the word कर्म is in composition with it and the sense of the word to be formed is that of wages.

3.2.23.e: The affix ट does not come after the verb कृ 'to make' when the following words are in composition with it - 1. शब्द 'sound' 2. श्लोक 'verse' 3. कलह 'quarrel' 4. गाथा 'praise' 5. वैर 'enmity' 6. चाटु 'flattery' 7. सूत्र 'thread' 8. मन्त्र 'hymns' 9. पद 'word'.

3.2.24.e: The affix इन् comes after the verb कृ when the objects in composition with it are the words स्तम्ब 'a sheaf' and शकृत् 'ordure'.

3.2.25.e: When the agent indicated is an animal, the affix इन् comes after the verb हृ 'to take', the object in composition with it being the words ददृति 'a leather bag' and नाथ 'a master'.

3.2.26.e: And the words फलेग्रहि and आत्मम्भरि are irregularly formed.

3.2.27.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix इन् comes after the verbs वन् 'to honour', सन् 'to worship', रक्ष् 'to protect' and अथ् 'to agitate', when the object is in composition.

3.2.28.e: The affix खश् comes after the verb एजृ 'to tremble' when ending in शि and when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.29.e: The affix खश् comes after the verbs ध्मा 'to blow' and धे 'to suck' when नासिका 'nose' and स्तन 'breast' are in composition with them as object.

3.2.30.e: And when the words नाडी 'a tube' and मुष्टि 'a fist' are objects in composition with the verbs ध्मा 'to blow' and धे 'to suck', the affix खश् is used.

3.2.31.e: The affix खश् comes after the verbs रुजि 'to break into pieces' and वह् 'to carry', when preceded by the उपसर्ग उत् and the word कूल 'bank' is in composition with them as the object.

3.2.32.e: The affix खश् comes after the verb लिह 'to lick' when the object in composition with it, is the word वह 'the shoulder of an ox' or अभ्र 'a cloud'.

3.2.33.e: The affix खश् comes after the verb पच् 'to cook' when the object in composition with it denotes a measure.

3.2.34.e: The affix खश् is used after the verb पच् 'to cook' when मित 'a measured partition' or नख 'a nail' is the word in composition with it as an object.

3.2.35.e: The affix खश् comes after the verb तुद् 'to strike' when विधु 'the moon' or अरुस् 'a wound' is the word in composition with it as object.

3.2.36.e: The affix खश् comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' and तप् 'to heat' when असूर्य and ललाट are the words in composition with it as object.

3.2.37.e: The words उग्रम्पश्य , इरम्मद , पाणिन्धम are irregularly formed.

3.2.38.e: The affix खच् comes after the verb वद् 'to speak' when प्रिय or वश is the word in composition with it as an object.

3.2.39.e: The affix खच् comes after the verb ताप् 'to heat' when द्विषत् or पर is the word in composition with it as an object.

3.2.40.e: The affix खच् comes after the verb यस् 'to curb' when the word वाक् 'speech' is in composition with it as an object and the sense indicated is that of a vow.

3.2.41.e: The affix खच् comes after the verb दारि 'to split' and सह् 'to bear' when respectively in composition with the words पुर् 'a city' and सर्व 'all', as objects.

3.2.42.e: The affix खच् comes after the verb कष् 'to rub' when the words सर्व 'all', कूल 'bank', अभ्र 'cloud' and करीष 'a dry cow-dung' are in composition with it as objects.

3.2.43.e: The affix खच् comes after the verb कृ 'to make' when the words मेघ 'cloud' अर्ति 'misfortune' and भय 'fear' are in composition as objects.

3.2.44.e: And the affix अण् as well as खच् come after the verb कृ 'to make' when the words क्षेम 'happiness', प्रिय 'pleasant' and भद्र 'joy' are in composition as objects.

3.2.45.e: The affix खच् comes after the verb भू 'to be' when in composition with the case-inflected word आशित 'satisfied by eating' and the sense is that of instrument or condition.

3.2.46.e: The affix खच् comes after the verbs - 1. भृ 'to bear' 2. तॄ 'to cross over' 3. वृ 'to choose' 4. जि 'to conquer' 5. धारि 'to hold' 6. सहि 'to bear' 7. तपि 'to heat' 8. दम 'to subdue'

3.2.47.e: And the affix खच् comes after the verb गम् 'to go' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix and when the word to be formed denotes a name.

3.2.48.e: And the affix खच् comes after the verb गम् 'to go' when in composition with the verbs - 1. अन्त 'end' 2. अत्यन्त 'extreme' 3. अध्वम् 'road' 4. दूर 'far' 5. पार 'across' 6. सर्व 'all' 7. अनन्त 'endless'.

3.2.49.e: The affix ड comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the object is in composition with it and when benediction is intended.

3.2.50.e: The affix ड comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when it is compounded with the preposition अप् and when the object in composition with it, is the word क्लेश 'pain' or तमस् 'darkness'.

3.2.51.e: The affix णिनि comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the word in composition with it is कुमार 'a child' or शीर्ष 'head'.

3.2.52.e: The affix टक् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when it is in composition with the word जाया 'wife' or पति 'husband' as object and when the word so formed denotes the agent possessed of that attribute (or when the word so formed denotes a mark).

3.2.53.e: The affix टक् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the object is in composition with it and when the word to be formed denotes an agent other than a human being.

3.2.54.e: The affix टक् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the object is in composition with it as its object is हस्ति 'elephant' or कपाट 'gate' and when the sense indicated is that of power.

3.2.55.e: The word पाणिघ and ताडघ are irregularly formed when denoting an artificier.

3.2.56.e: The affix ख्युन् , when in the sense of the word to be formed is that of an instrumental agent, comes after the verb कृ 'to make', when the following words are in composition with it - 1. आढ्य 'rich' 2. सुभग 'fortunate' 3. स्थूल 'big' 4. पलित 'grey' 5. नग्न 'naked' 6. अन्ध 'blind' 7. प्रिय 'pleasant', provided these words formed by the affix च्वि though not actually ending in the affix च्वि।

3.2.57.e: The affixes खिष्णुच् and खकञ् , when the word to be formed denotes an agent comes after the verb भू 'to become', when it is in composition with the words formed by the affix च्वि though not actually ending in the affix च्वि।

3.2.58.e: The affix क्विन् comes after the verb स्पृश् 'to touch' when it is in composition with a case-inflected word other than उदक 'water'.

3.2.59.e: The words - ऋत्विक्, दधृष्, स्रज् , दिश्, उष्णिह् - are considered to be readymade forms made using the क्विन् प्रत्यय. Also, the verb अञ्च् gets the क्विन् प्रत्यय in presence of an उपपद, where as the verbs युज् and  क्रुञ्च् get the क्विन् प्रत्यय in absence of an उपपद.

3.2.60.e: And the affix कञ् comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' when it is in composition with त्यद् etc. and does not signify perception.

3.2.61.e: The affix क्विप्comes after the following verbs when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix, though it may be an उपसर्ग viz. 1. सत् 'to sit' 2. सू 'to bring forth' 3. द्विष् 'to hate' 4. द्रुह् 'to bear malice' 5. दुह् 'to milk' 6. युज् 'to join' , 'to concentrate the mind' 7. विद् 'to know', 'to consider' 8. भिद् 'to divide' 9. च्छिद् 'to cut' 10. जि 'to conquer' 11. नी 'to lead 12. राज् 'to shine'.

3.2.62.e: The affix ण्वि comes after the verb भज् 'to share' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix whether it be an उपसर्ग or not.

3.2.63.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix णिव comes after the verb सह् 'to bear' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix.

3.2.64.e: The affix णिव after the verb वह् 'to carry' in the छन्दस् (Vedas), when the word ending in case-affix is in composition with it.

3.2.65.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix ञ्युट् comes after the verb वह् 'to carry' when it is in composition with the words कव्य 'oblation of food to deceased ancestors', पुरीष 'faeces' and पुरीष्य 'water'.

3.2.66.e: The affix ञ्युट् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verb वह् 'to carry' when it is in composition with the word हव्य 'an oblation to gods', provided that the word so formed does not occur in the middle of a पाद (4th part of a stanza).

3.2.67.e: The affix विट् (the whole of which is elided) comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verbs 1. जन् 'to be born' 2. सन् 'to bestow' 3. खन् 'to dig' 4. क्रम् 'to pace' 5. गम् 'to go' when a word ending in case-affix is in composition and the final nasals are changed into long आ।

3.2.68.e: The affix विट् comes after the verb अद् 'to eat' when in composition with a case-inflected word other than अन्न 'food'.

3.2.69.e: The affix विट् comes after the verb अद् 'to eat' when the word क्रव्य is in composition with it.

3.2.70.e: The affix कप् comes after the verb दुह् 'to milk' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix and the letter घ replaces the final.

3.2.71.e: In the मन्त्र literature,the affix णिवन् comes after the words 1. श्वेतवह 2.उक्थश 3. पुरोडाश् ।

3.2.72.e: In the मन्त्र literature,the affix णिवन् comes after the verb यज् 'to sacrifice' when in composition the word अव्।

3.2.73.e: The affix विच् comes after the verb यज् 'to sacrifice' when उप precedes it, in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.2.74.e: The affixes मनिन् (मन्), वनिप् (वन्), विनय (वन्) and विच् come in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verbs which end in long आ , when used in a case-inflected word or उपसर्ग in in composition.

3.2.75.e: These affixes i.e. - मनिन् (मन्), वनिप् (वन्), विनय (वन्) and विच् are seen after other verbs also besides those ending in long आ।

3.2.76.e: And the affix क्विप् is also seen after all verbs, whether having an उपपद or not in the Vedic as well as in the modern Sanskrit.

3.2.77.e: The affixes क and क्विप् come after the verb स्था when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix or an उपसर्ग ।

3.2.78.e: When habit is to be expressed, the affix णिनि comes after a verb, provided the word with a case-affix in composition with it does not mean a genus.

3.2.79.e: The affix णिनि comes after a verb when in composition with a word denoting an object of comparison, expressing the agent, the sense of the affix being 'doing something like that', that is to say, when the उपपद agent is the standard of comparison of the agent denoted by the word to which the sense of the affix refers.

3.2.80.e: The affix णिनि comes after a verb, in composition with a word ending in a case-affix.

3.2.81.e: The affix णिनि comes after a verb diversely when continued repitition of an action is to be expressed.

3.2.82.e: The affix णिनि comes after the verb मन् 'to think' when there is a word with a case-affix in composition with it.

3.2.83.e: And the affix णिनि comes after the verb मन् 'to think' when the word in composition with it is a word with a case-affix and when it is used to signify thought, whereof the object is self (the sense of the affix being 'thinking himself as such').

3.2.84.e: All the affixes to be treated of hereafter should be understood to come in the sense of past time.

3.2.85.e: The affix णिनि comes after the verb यज् 'to sacrifice' with the sense of past time, when the word in composition is the Instrumental -3rd case.

3.2.86.e: The affix णिनि comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time, when the word in composition is in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.87.e: The affix क्विप्comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time when the following words in the Accusative -2nd case ae in composition - 1. भ्रूण 'a foetus' 2. वृत्र ।

3.2.88.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix क्विप्diversely comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time,ending with the word even when the word in composition with it is other than those mentioned in the last sūtra.

3.2.89.e: The affix क्विप्comes after the verb कृ 'to make' with the sense of past time, when the following words in the Accusative -2nd case are in composition - 1. सु 'action' 2. कर्म 'action' 3. पाप 'sin' 4. मन्त्र 'hymn' 5. पुण्य 'virtue'.

3.2.90.e: The affix क्विप्comes after the verb सु 'to press out juice' with the sense of past time, when the word सोम , in the Accusative -2nd case, is in composition.

3.2.91.e: The affix क्विप्comes after the verb चि 'to collect' with the sense of past time, when the word अग्नि , in the Accusative -2nd case, is in composition.

3.2.92.e: In expressing an object the affix क्विप्comes after the verb चि 'to collect' with the sense of past time when in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case, provided the word so formed is the name of fire.

3.2.93.e: The affix इनि comes after the compound verb विकृ 'to sell' in the sense of past time, when in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.94.e: The affix क्वनिप् comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' in the sense of past time, when in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.95.e: The affix क्वनिप् comes after the verbs युध 'to fight' and कृ 'to make' with a past signification when the word राजन् 'king' is in composition, in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.96.e: The affix क्वनिप् comes after the verbs युध 'to fight' and कृ 'to make' with a past signification when the word सह 'with', is in composition.

3.2.97.e: The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the word, in composition with it is in the Locative -7th-case.

3.2.98.e: The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the word, in composition with it is in the Ablative -5th case, which does not denote a genus.

3.2.99.e: The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when an उपसर्ग is in composition and when the sense is simply appellative.

3.2.100.e: The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the root takes the preposition अनु and is compounded with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.101.e: The affix ड is seen to come after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification,though it be in composition with other nouns, having cases other than those mentioned in the previous sūtras.

3.2.102.e: The affixes called निष्ठा come after a verbal root used in the sense of past time.

3.2.103.e: The affix ङ्वनिप् comes after the verbs सु 'to press out or extract juice' and यज् 'to sacrifice', with a past signification.

3.2.104.e: The affix अतृन् comes after the verb जृ 'to grow old' with the sense of past time.

3.2.105.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix लिट् (Perfect Tense) comes after a verb with a past signification.

3.2.106.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix लिट् (Perfect Tense) is optionally replaced by the affix कानच्।

3.2.107.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix क्वसु is optionally the substitute for लिट् ।

3.2.108.e: In modern Sanskrit the affix क्वसु optionally replaces लिट् (Perfect Tense) after the verbs सद् , वस् and श्रु with a past signification.

3.2.109.e: The forms उपेयिवान् , नाश्वान् , नूचान् are irregularly formed.

3.2.110.e: The लुङ्-प्रत्ययः is used to indicate the past tense.

3.2.111.a: अनद्यतने भूते धातोः परः लङ् प्रत्ययः
3.2.111.e: लङ्-लकार is used to indicate actions that have happened yesterday or before.

3.2.112.e: When a word implying 'recollection' is in connection with it, a verb takes the affix लृट् (2nd Future) in the sense of the past before the commencement of the present day.

3.2.113.e: The affix लृट् (2nd Future) is not applied in the sense of the past when the उपपद denoting recollection has in connection with it the particle यत्।

3.2.114.e: The affix लृट् (2nd Future) is optionally applied in the sense of the past, when a word implying 'recollection' is in connection with it and whether such a word has the particle यत् or is used simply; provided that the two verbs, occurring in the same complex sentence, are also connected together, that each is necessary to the other , to complete the sense of the speaker.

3.2.115.a: परोक्षे अनद्यतने भूते धातोः परः लिट् प्रत्ययः
3.2.115.e: लिट्-लकार is used to indicate an action which was done yesterday or before and which was not seen by the speaker of the sentence.

3.2.116.e: And the affix लङ् (Imperfect Tense) comes after the verb when the particles ह and शश्वत are in connection with it and when the verb denotes past action unperceived by the speaker and before the commencement of the current day.

3.2.117.e: The affixes लङ् (Imperfect Tense) and लिट् (Perfect Tense) come after a verb (in expressing a past time not belonging to the current day and unperceived by the speaker) when the past referred to is recent and the sentence is interrogative.

3.2.118.e: The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a verb when the particle स्म is in connection with it (and denotes a past time not belonging to the current day and unperceived by the speaker). Note : This debars लिट् (Perfect Tense) .

3.2.119.e: The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a verb when the particle स्म is in connection with it and denotes a past action not belonging to the current day and when the action is perceived by the agent.

3.2.120.e: The affix लट् (Present Tense) is used after a verb in denoting a past action when the word ननु is in connection with it and an answer is given to the question.

3.2.121.e: The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes optionally after a verb in denoting past time, in reply to an interrogation, when the words न 'not' and नु 'what of that' are in connection with it.

3.2.122.e: Optionally the affixes लुङ् (Aorist) and लट् (Present Tense) come after a verb in denoting past time not belonging to the current day, when the word पुरा is used in the sentence, provided that the word स्म is not used.

3.2.123.e: The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a verb when denoting a present action.

3.2.124.a: लटः अप्रथमासमानाधिकरणे वर्तमाने शतृशानचौ धातोः परः
3.2.124.e: The लट्-लकार gets शतृ and शानच् as आदेशाः to denote the present-tense, provided a विभक्ति other than प्रथमा is used along with these.

3.2.125.e: The affixes शतृ and शानच् are substitutes of लट् (Present Tense) even when agreeing with what ends with a 1st (Nominative Case) case-affix, provided that it is in the Vocative Case.

3.2.126.e: The affixes शतृ and शानच् are substitutes of लट् (Present Tense) and come after a verb in expressing an attendant circumstance or characteristic and the cause of an action.

3.2.127.e: These two - शतृ and शानच् are called सत्.

3.2.128.e: The affix शानन् comes after the verbs पू 'to purify' and यज् 'to sacrifice'.

3.2.129.e: The affix चानश् comes after a verb in expressing 'habit', standard of age' and 'inability'.

3.2.130.e: The affix शतृ comes after the verb इङ् 'to go' and धारि 'to hold' in denoting that the agent does the action without trouble.

3.2.131.e: The affix शतृ comes after the verb द्विष् when the agent indicated means 'an enemy'.

3.2.132.e: The affix शतृ comes after the verb सु 'to press out or extract juice' when the sense is that of association with sacrifice.

3.2.133.e: The affix शतृ comes after the verb अर्ह in expressing praise.

3.2.134.e: From this sūtra as far as क्विप् in sūtra [[3.4.177]] (inclusive), the affixes that we shall treat of, are to be understood in the sense of agents having such a habit or nature or having skill in such and such action.

3.2.137.e: The affix इष्णुच् in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verb that ends in the causative णि।
3.2.137.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु

3.2.138.e: The affix इष्णुच् in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verb भू 'to be' etc.
3.2.138.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु

3.2.139.e: The affix क्स्नु comes after the following verbs in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' viz. - 1. ग्ला 'to be weary' 2. जि 'to conquer' 3. स्था 'to stand', as well as after भू 'to be'.
3.2.139.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु

3.2.140.e: The affix क्नु comes after the verbs - 1. त्रस् 'to tremble' 2. गृध् 'to be greedy' 3. धृष् 'to be bold' 4. क्षिप् 'to throw' in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.'.
3.2.140.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु

3.2.141.e: The affix घिनुण् comes after the 8 verbs beginning with शम् 'to be calm' in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.'.

3.2.142.e: The affix घिनुण् comes after the following verbs in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.'. - 1. संपृच् 2. अनुरुध् 3. आङ्यम् 4. आङ्यस् 5. परिसृ 6. संसृज् 7. परिदेवि 8. संज्वर् 9. परिक्षिप् 10. परिरट् 11. परिवद् 12. परिदह् 13. परिमुह् 14. दुष् 15. द्विष् 16. द्रुह् 17. दुह् 18. युज् 19. आक्रीड् 20. विविच् 21. त्यज् 22. रज् 23. भज् 24 अतिचर् 25. अपचर् 26. आमुष् 27. अभ्याहन्।

3.2.143.e: The affix घिनुण् comes after the verbs कष् 'to injure', लस् 'to embrace and sport', कत्थ 'to praise' and स्रम्भ 'to believe', when these are in composition with the preposition वि।

3.2.144.e: The affix घिनुण् comes after the verb लष 'to wish' when compounded with the preposition अप and वि।
3.2.144.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु

3.2.147.e: The affix वुञ् comes after the verbs देवि 'to lament' and क्रुश 'to cry' when an उपसर्ग is in composition with them.
3.2.147.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु

3.2.148.e: The affix युच् comes, in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' after intransitive verbs denoting 'motion' or 'sound'.
3.2.148.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु

3.2.153.e: The affix युच् does not come after the verbs सूद् 'to strike', दीप् 'to shine' and दीक्ष् 'to initiate'.

3.2.155.e: The affix षाकन् comes, in the sense of 'agent having such habit etc.' after the following verbs - 1. जल्प् 2. भिक्ष् 3. कुट्ट 4. लुण्ट 5.वृङ ।
