3.3.96.e: In the मन्त्र literature, क्तिन् acutely accented comes after the following roots, forming words in feminine gender, denoting a 'mere action' 1. वृष् 'to rain' 2. इष् 'to wish 3. पच् 'to cook' 4. मन् 'to think' 5. विद् 'to know' 6. भू 'to be' 7. वि 'to go, to consume' 8. रा 'to give'.
3.3.96.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.97.e: And these words viz. 1. ऊति 'preserving sport' 2. यूति 'joining' 3. जूति 'velocity' 4. साति 'destruction' 5. हेति 'a weapon' 6. कीर्ति 'fame', are anomalous forms, acutely accented (उदात्त).
3.3.97.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.98.e: The affix क्यप् comes after a roots 1. व्रज 'to go' 2. यज् 'to worship' acutely accented (उदात्त) in forming a word in the feminine denoting action.
3.3.98.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.99.e: The affix क्यप् comes after the following verbs in forming a word in the feminine denoting an 'appellative 'and is acutely accented (उदात्त) viz. 1. समज 2. निषद 3. निपत 4. मन 5. विद 6. षुञ् 7. शीङ् 8. भृञ् 9. इण्
3.3.99.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.100.e: And after the root कृ comes the affix श in forming a feminine as well as the affix क्यप्।
3.3.100.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.101.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.102.e: After the verbs that end in an affix, there is the affix अ, the word being feminine.
3.3.102.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.103.e: The affix अ comes after a verb which has a prosodially heavy vowel and ends in a consonant when the word to be formed is feminine.
3.3.103.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.104.e: The affix अण् comes after those verbs that have an indicatory षि and after भिद् when the word to be formed is feminine.
3.3.104.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.105.e: The affix अण् as well as the affix युच् come after the following verbs, forming feminine words - 1. चिन्त् 'to think' 2. पूज् 'to worship' 3. कथ् 'to narrate' 4. कुम्ब् 'to cover' 5. चर्च् 'to learn'
3.3.105.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.106.e: The affix अण् comes after those verbs which end in long आ when an उपसर्ग is in composition and when the word to be formed is feminine.
3.3.106.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.107.e: After verbs ending in णि and after आस् 'to sit' and श्रन्थ् 'to loose', there is the affix युच् when the word to be formed is feminine.
3.3.107.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.108.e: The affix ण्वुल् comes diversely after verbs when the word to be formed is feminine noun, being the name of 'diseases'.
3.3.108.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.109.e: The affix ण्वुल् comes after the verbal roots, when the word to be formed is an appellative.
3.3.109.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.110.e: And the affix इञ् comes optionally after a root when a question and answer is expressed (as well as ण्वुल् and other affixes ordained by other rules).
3.3.110.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.111.e: The affix ण्वुच् comes optionally after a root in the sense of succession, merit, debt or production.
3.3.111.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.112.e: The affix अनि comes after a verb when the particle नञ् is in composition with it and the sense implied is that of 'cursing'.
3.3.112.k: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम् · स्त्रियाम्

3.3.113.e: The affixes called कृत्य -- कृत्याः प्राङ् ण्वुलः [[3.1.95]], and the affix ल्युट् , are diversely applicable and have other senses than those taught before.

3.3.114.e: The affix क्त is added to the root when action is expressed, the word being in the neuter gender.

3.3.115.e: The affix ल्युट् is added to the root when the name of an action is expressed, in the neuter gender.

3.3.116.e: The affix ल्युट् is added to a root when the name of an action is expressed, in the neuter gender provided that the verb has in construction with it, such a word in the Accusative -2nd case, as indicates the thing, from the contact with which, there arises a pleasant sensation corporally to the agent.

3.3.117.e: The affix ल्युट् is added to a root when the relation of the word so formed to the verb is that of an instrument or location.

3.3.118.e: The affix घ generally comes in the sense of an instrument or location after a root, when the word to be formed is a name and is in the masculine gender.

3.3.119.e: And the words 1. गोचर 2. संचर 3. वह 4. व्रज 5. व्यज 6. आपण 7. निगम are anomalous.

3.3.120.e: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. तॄ 'to cross' 2. स्तॄ 'to spread, to cover', when the उपसर्ग अव is in composition with them and when the word so formed is an appellative related to the verb either as an instrument or as a location.

3.3.121.e: And after a verb ending in a consonant, comes the affix घञ् (when the word to be formed is masculine and related to the verb as an instrument or a location and thereby the palatal is changed into guttural).

3.3.122.e: And the words 1. अध्याय 2. न्याय 3. उद्याव 4. संहार 5. आधारा 6. आवयाः are anomalous.

3.3.123.e: The word उदङ्क is anomalous when the sense of the root refers to subjects other than 'water'.

3.3.124.e: The word आनाय is irregularly formed when the meaning is 'a net'.

3.3.125.e: The affix घ as well as घञ् come after the verb खन् 'to dig' when the word to be formed is an appellative related to the verb as an instrument or location.

3.3.126.e: In the sense of 'hard and difficult' or 'light and easy' the affix खल् is added to a verb when ईषद् and दुर् and सु are combined with it as उपपद-s.

3.3.127.e: The affix खल् comes after the verbs भू 'to be' and कृ when the उपपद-s in composition with them are 'agent' and 'object' respectively, preceded by the words ईषद् etc. in combination with them, meaning 'hard or light'.

3.3.128.e: The affix युच् comes after the roots ending in long आ (when ईषद् and दुर् and सु are combined as उपपद-sūtras, in the sense of easily or with difficulty).

3.3.129.e: The affix युच् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the roots having the sense of 'to go' when the word ईषद् etc. meaning 'lightly' or 'with difficulty' are in composition with such verbs.

3.3.130.e: The affix युच् is seen to come number the छन्दस् (Vedas) after other verbs also, than those meaning 'to go'

3.3.131.e: The affixes which are used when the sense is that of present time, may, optionally in like manner, be used when the sense is that of past or future time not remote from the present.

3.3.132.e: The affixes which are used when the sense is that of past time or of the present time, may, optionally, in like manner, be used after a root in denoting future time when hope is expressed.

3.3.133.e: When the word क्षिप्र 'quickly' or its synonym is in construction with the verb, the future affix लृट् (2nd Future) is used after the root when 'hope' is expressed in a conditional form.

3.3.134.e: The affix of the Potential is used in denoting Futurity after a root, when the उपपद in composition with it is a word expressing 'hope'.

3.3.135.e: When constant continuance of action or a near Past or Future is meant, the Past and Future are not denoted as taught in अनद्यतने लङ् [[3.2.111]] and अनद्यतने लुट् [[3.3.15]], through the Imperfect and the II Future, but through the Aorist and the First Future.

3.3.136.e: The Futurity is not expressed, as taught in अनद्यतने लुट् [[3.3.15]] through the II Future, but through the I Future, when a statement is made of a limit on this (अवर) side of another place.

3.3.137.e: The II Future is used instead of the I Future in denoting Future time not belonging to the current day when the word अवर is used together with a word expressing division of time, but not when it is a word giving the sense of 'day' or 'night'.

3.3.138.e: Optionally so, when a declaration is made with regard to that side of a limit of time.

3.3.139.e: In the context of future, if the cause-effect scenario is being described with an implication that the action did not happen, the लृङ्लकारः is used.

3.3.140.e: And (where there is a reason for affixing लिङ् (Benedictive) , the affix ऌङ् (Conditional Future) is to be used, when the non-completion of the action is to be understood) if the sense is that of past time.

3.3.141.e: From this point up to sūtra उताप्योः समर्थयोर्लिङ् [[3.3.152]] (the whole of the following sentence is to be taken as exerting a governing the influence on the sūtras that follow; where there is a reason for affix लिङ् (Benedictive) , the ऌङ् (Conditional Future) may be) optionally (used in denoting the past time, when the non-completion of the action is to be understood).

3.3.142.e: The affix लट् (Present Tense) is used after a root when it has in composition with it the wordsअपि or जातु , the sense implied by the sentence being that of 'censure'.

3.3.143.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) as well as लट् (Present Tense) is optionally used after a root when the word कथम् is in construction with it and censure is implied.

3.3.144.e: The affixes लिङ् (Benedictive) and लृट् (I Future) come after a verb when the interrogative words like किम् etc. are in composition with it and censure is implied.

3.3.145.e: When it is to be expressed that somebody hold that something is not likely to take place or is not to be tolerated, the Potential and the I Future are used, even without the Interrogative Pronoun.

3.3.146.e: The affix लृट् (I Future) is used after a root when the words किंकिल or those having the sense of अस्ति 'he is' are in construction with it (when the action is not likely to occur, or is not to be tolerated).

3.3.147.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a root, the words जातु and यत् being in construction with it, when the sense is that the action is not believed to be likely or is not to be tolerated.

3.3.148.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a root in all tenses when the words यच्च and यत्र are in composition with it, provided that censure is implied.

3.3.149.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes in all tenses when the words यच्च and यत्र are in composition with it, provided that censure is implied.

3.3.150.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes in all tenses when used with the words यच्च and यत्र and the sense implied is that of 'wonder'.

3.3.151.e: In all the cases when 'wonder' is implied by word other than यच्च and यत्र , the affix लृट् (I Future) is used after a root, except when the word यदि is used.

3.3.152.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a verb in all tenses when the words उत and अपि , both having the same meaning, are in composition.

3.3.153.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a root, in expressing or making known of a wish, except when the word कच्चित् is in composition with it.

3.3.154.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) is used after a root, when the expectation (of a person or thing being able or competent to do or suffer the action denoted by the verb is implied (or expressed by any other word used along with them) than 'alarm'.

3.3.155.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) is optionally used after a verb when it has another verb which expresses 'expectation' in construction with it, but not so when the word यत् is used.

3.3.156.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) is optionally used after those verbs which express the condition and its consequence.

3.3.157.e: The affixes लिङ् (Benedictive) and लोट् (Imperative) are used after a root when another verb having the same sense of 'wishing' is in construction with it.

3.3.158.e: The affix तुमुन् comes after a verb when another verb meaning 'to wish' is in construction, provided that the agent of both the verbs is the same.

3.3.159.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) is used after a verb when the verbs meaning 'to wish' are in construction with it and the agent of both the verbs is the same.

3.3.160.e: After roots meaning 'to wish' the लिङ् (Benedictive) is optionally used denoting the present time.

3.3.161.e: लिङ्लकार  can be used to indicate विधि (= order) , निमन्त्रण ( = an invitation that cannot be rejected), आमन्त्रण  (= an invitation that can be rejected), अधीष्ट (= Ask something with respect, often in exchange of money or something else), सम्प्रश्न (= A question about doing or not doing something) and प्रार्थना (= request).

3.3.162.e: लोट्लकार can be used to indicate विधि (= order) , निमन्त्रण ( = an invitation that cannot be rejected), आमन्त्रण (= an invitation that can be rejected), अधीष्ट (= Ask something with respect, often in exchange of money or something else), सम्प्रश्न (= A question about doing or not doing something) and प्रार्थना (= request).

3.3.163.e: The affixes called कृत्य and the affix लोट् (Imperative) come also after verbs, in the sense of direction, granting permission and proper (particular) time.

3.3.164.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) (as well as कृत्य and लोट् (Imperative) ) is used (under similar circumstances in the sense of 1. direction 2. permission etc.) when the time is future by a मुहूर्त (48 minutes or an Indian hour); (or the Potential may be used as well when it signifies 'at this very moment').

3.3.165.e: The affix लोट् (Imperative) comes after a verb when the word स्म is in composition (when the sense is that of 'direction', permission etc.) and referring to time by a मुहूर्त (48 minutes or an Indian hour).

3.3.166.e: And when 'wish' is meant ( the लोट् (Imperative) may be used when the word स्म is in composition with the verb.

3.3.167.e: The affix तुमुन् comes after a root when the words 1. काल 2. समय 3. वेला (all meaning time) are in composition.

3.3.168.e: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a root when the word यद् is in composition and the words 1. काल 2. समय 3. वेला occur in construction.

3.3.169.e: The affixes कृत्य and the affix तृच are added to a root when fitness as regards the agent is implied (as well as in the affix लिङ् (Benedictive) ).

3.3.170.e: The affix णिनि is added to the root in denoting agent, showing that there is some 'necessity' or 'indebtedness' or 'obligation' on the part of the agent in connection with the action denoted by the verb.

3.3.171.e: The affixes called कृत्य also come after a root when the sense to be indicated is that of 'necessity' or 'obligation'.

3.3.172.e: And the affix लिङ् (Benedictive) as well as the कृत्य affixes come after a verb when the sense is that of 'capability'.

3.3.173.e: लिङ्लकार and लोट्लकार are used to express the desire of something that cannot be easily attained.

3.3.174.e: The affixes क्तिच् and क्त are used after a root when benediction is intended, provided that the whole word so formed is an appellative.

3.3.175.e: In presence of the अव्यय माङ्, लुङ्लकारः is used.

3.3.176.e: When माङ् is followed by स्म, the verb लुङ्लकार or लङ्लकार is used.

3.4.1.e: When there is a syntactical relation between the senses of the verbs, the affixes are valid, even in denoting time other than that for which they have been specifically enjoined.

3.4.2.e: When the (frequency of) repetition of an action is indicated, the affix लोट् (Imperative) is added to the root and the verb is repeated. And the affixes हि and स्व or the affixes त and ध्वम् are the substitutes of लोट् (Imperative).

3.4.3.e: The affix लोट् (Imperative) is similarly added to the root optionally when several themes follow one after another.

3.4.4.e: In the first case -- क्रियासमभिहारे लोट्, लोटो हिस्वौ, वा च तध्वमोः [[3.4.2]] the same verb must be used in the subsequent clause, as the verb which was put in the लोट् (Imperative Mood) .

3.4.5.e: In the second case -- समुच्चयेऽन्यतरस्याम् [[3.4.3]], where many actions are spoken of together, the verb that is made to follow, should be such as has the sense common to all those verbs.

3.4.6.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the लुङ् (Aorist), लङ् (Imperfect Tense) and लिट् (Perfect Tense) are optionally used in all tenses, in relation to verbs.

3.4.7.e: The affix लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive) is optionally used the छन्दस् (Vedas) wherever the लिङ् (Benedictive) can be used.

3.4.8.e: Where a contingent promise (a reciprocal agreement) or apprehension is implied, the affix लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive) is used after a root in the छन्दस् (Vedas) Literature.

3.4.9.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the following affixes come after the roots with the force of the affix तुमुन् , viz. 1. से 2. सेन् 3. असे 4. असेन् 5. क्से 6. क्सेन् 7. अध्यै 8. अध्यैन् 9. कध्यै 10. कध्यैन् 11. शाध्यै 12. शाध्यैन् 13. तवै 14. तवै 15. तवैन् ।

3.4.10.e: The words 1. प्रयै 2. रोहिष्यै 3. अव्यथिष्यै are irregularly formed Vedic Infinitives.

3.4.11.e: The words 1. दृशे 2. विख्ये are anomalous Vedic Infinitives.

3.4.12.e: The affixes णमुल् and कमुल् are added to roots in the छन्दस् (Vedas) to form Infinitives, when they are governed by the verb शक् 'to be able'.

3.4.13.e: The affixes तोसुन् and कसुन् are added to roots in the छन्दस् (Vedas) to form Infinitives, when the word ईश्वर is in composition.

3.4.14.e: The affixes 1. तवै 2. केन् 3. केन्य 4. त्वन् are added to roots in the छन्दस् (Vedas), in the sense of कृत्य-affixes.

3.4.15.e: The word of अवचक्षे is an anomalous passive participle in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.4.16.e: The affix तोसुन् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the following verbs, when mere name of the action is indicated viz. 1. स्था 'to stand' 2. इण् 'to go' 3. कृञ् 'to make' 4. वद् 'to speak' 5. चर् 'to go, to walk' 6. हु 'to sacrifice' 7. तम् 'to grow tired' 8. जन् 'to produce' ।

3.4.17.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix कसुन् comes after the verbs 1. सृप् 'to creep' 2. तृद् 'to injure' , in the sense of Infinitives indicating name of action.

3.4.18.e: According to the opinion of the Eastern Grammarians, the affix क्त्वा comes after the verb, when there are in combination with it, the words अलम् and खलु expressing the sense of prohibition.

3.4.19.e: According to the opinion of the Eastern Grammarians, the affix क्त्वा is added to the root मेन् 'to exchange' when the sense is that of interchange, (though the action denoted by the former word is not prior to the action denoted by the latter word).

3.4.20.e: The affix क्त्वा is added to a root, to denote what is situated on the side - पर or on this side of something - अवर।

3.4.21.e: When two actions have the same agent, the affix क्त्वा comes after that verb which takes place in time anterior to that of the other (i.e. Absolutive in त्व refers to that action which precedes in time).

3.4.22.e: The affixes णमुल् and क्त्वा come after a root when reiteration is to be expressed.

3.4.23.e: The affixes णमुल् and क्त्वा are not added to a root when the word यद् is used in a simple sentence which does not depend upon another to complete the sense.

3.4.24.e: The affixes णमुल् and क्त्वा come optionally after that verb which denotes the prior action, when both verbs have the same agent, provided that the following words are in composition - 1. अग्रे 2. प्रथम 3. पूर्व।

3.4.25.e: The affix खमुञ् is added to the verb कृ 'to make', when a word in the Accusative -2nd case is in construction with it, if the sense intended implies 'abuse'.

3.4.26.e: (When the actions signified by the verbs कृ 'to make' and another have the same agent), the affix णमुल् is added to the verb कृ 'to make' which is concerned about a time anterior to that of the other), provided that a word signifying 'sweet' is in composition.

3.4.27.e: When the words 1. अन्यथा 'otherwise' 2. एवम् 'so' 3. कथम् 'how' 4. इत्थम् 'thus' are compounded with the verb, the णमुल् comes after कृ 'to make', if it be such that its omission would be unobjectionable.

3.4.28.e: The affix णमुल् is added to the root कृ 'to make', the words 1. यथा 2. तथा being compounded with it when an angry reply is made (if the omission of कृञ् is unobjectionable).

3.4.29.e: When the object is compounded with it, the verb दृश् 'to see' or विद् 'to know' takes the affix णमुल् to denote the total number of such objects.

3.4.30.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb विद् 'to know' and जीव् 'to live' when the word यावत् is combined with them.

3.4.31.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पुर् 'to fill' when the word चर्मन् and उदर् are compounded with it.

3.4.32.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पुर् 'to fill' when the word so formed expresses a measure of rainfall and optionally the long ऊ of this पुर् is elided.

3.4.33.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the causative of the root क्नूय् 'to wet', when there is compounded with a noun denoting 'clothing', in the Accusative -2nd case, as an उपपद , if the whole word so formed expresses a measure of the rainfall.

3.4.34.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb कष् 'to rub' when the words निमूल and समूल are compounded with it in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.4.35.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पिष् 'to grind', when the words 1. शुष्क 'dry' 2. चूर्ण 'powder' 3. रूक्षे 'dry', in the Accusative -2nd case are compounded with it.

3.4.36.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs 1. हन् 'to kill' 2. कृ 'to make' 3. ग्रह् 'to seize', when the words 1. समूल 2. आकृत 3. जीव in the Accusative -2nd case are respectively compounded with them.

3.4.37.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when a word in the Instrumental -3rd case is in composition with it.

3.4.38.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पिष् 'to grind' when a word in the Instrumental -3rd case denoting 'liquid' is in composition.

3.4.39.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs वर्त्ति (the causative of वृत्) and ग्रह् 'to seize' when a word denoting 'hand' in the Instrumental -3rd case, is in composition.

3.4.40.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पुष् 'to feed' when a word in the Instrumental -3rd case having the sense of स्व is in composition.

3.4.41.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the बन्ध् 'to bind' when a word expressing location is in construction with it.

3.4.42.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the बन्ध् 'to bind' when a word so formed denotes an appellative.

3.4.43.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the roots नश् 'to destroy' and वह् 'to carry' when the words जीव 'life' and पुरुष 'person' expressing the agent of these verbs, are respectively in construction with them.

3.4.44.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the roots शुष् 'to dry' and पूर् 'to fill' when the word ऊर्ध्व denoting an agent is in composition with them.

3.4.45.e: The affix णमुल् comes after a root when an object or an agent denoting similitude is in composition with it.

3.4.46.e: The same verb should be used after the gerunds formed from the verbs कष् 'to rub' etc. as the verb from which the gerund is derived.

3.4.47.e: The affix णमुल् comes after a root दंश् 'to bite' preceded by the preposition उप when a word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case is in composition with it..

3.4.48.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the roots having the sense of हिंस 'to injure, to strike' when the object of this gerund is the same as the object of the main verb and when the noun with which it is compounded ends with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix.

3.4.49.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the roots 1. पीड् 'to press' 2. रुद्ध् 'to obstruct' 3. कृष् 'to draw' when they are preceded by the preposition उप and when they are compounded with nouns ending with the Locative -7th case-affix.

3.4.50.e: (The affix णमुल् comes after a root when a word in the Locative -7th case or Instrumental -3rd case is in composition with it) and when immediate contiguity is intended i.e. 'to fall together by the ears'.

3.4.51.e: The affix णमुल् comes after a root when a noun in the Instrumental -3rd case or Locative -7th case is in composition with it and when measure of length is intended.

3.4.52.e: The affix णमुल् is added to the root when a noun in the Ablative -5th case is in composition and when 'haste' is intended.

3.4.53.e: The affix णमुल् is added to the root when a word in the Accusative -2nd case is in composition and when 'haste' is intended.

3.4.54.e: The affix णमुल् comes after a verb when a word in the Accusative -2nd case is in composition, signifying the limbs of one's own body, when the limb is such that its loss will not destroy life.

3.4.55.e: The affix णमुल् comes after a root when a word in the Accusative -2nd case denoting a limb of one's own body, which is completely afflicted by the action, is in composition.

3.4.56.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs 1. विश् 'to enter' 2. पत् 'to fall' 3. पद् 'to pace, to go' 4. स्कन्द् 'to leap', when a word in Accusative -2nd case is in composition and when the sense denoted is that of complete pervasion and total absorption.

3.4.57.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs 1. अस् 'to throw' 2. तृष् 'to be thirsty' when it is intended to express an intermission of the action denoted by the root, provided that a word in the Accusative -2nd case denoting time is in composition.

3.4.58.e: The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs 1. आदिश् 2. ग्रह् 'to seize' when the word नामन् 'name' in the Accusative -2nd case is in composition.

3.4.59.e: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् come after the root कृ 'to make' when an indeclinable word in composition with it and the meaning is the communication of anything in a disagreeable or undesired way.

3.4.60.e: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् come after the root कृ 'to make' when the word त्रियक् is in composition in the sense of 'carrying to the end'.

3.4.61.e: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् are added to the roots कृ 'to make' and भू 'to be', in composition with a word denoting a member of one's own body when the affix तस् is joined thereto.

3.4.62.e: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् are added to the roots कृ 'to make' and भू 'to be', when a word ending in the affix ना -- विनञ्भ्यां नानाञौ नसह [[5.2.27]], or in an affix having the force of धा -- संख्याया विधाऽर्थे धा [[5.3.42]], or having the sense of the affix च्वि 'to make or to become something with it had not been before' -- अभूततद्भावे कृभ्वस्तियोगे सम्पद्यकर्तरि च्विः [[5.4.50]], is in composition.

3.4.63.e: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् are added to the roots भू 'to be', when the word तूष्णीम् 'silently' is in composition.

3.4.64.e: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् come after the root भू 'to be' when the word अन्वक् in the sense of being favourably disposed, is in composition.

3.4.65.e: The affix तुमुन् is added to every verb when another verb having the sense of 1. शक् 'to be able' 2. धृष् 'to make bold' 3. ज्ञा 'to know' 4. ग्लै 'to be weary' 5. घट् 'to strive' 6. रभ् 'to begin' 7. लभ् 'to get' 8. क्रम् 'to set about' 9. सह् 'to bear' 10. अर्ह् 'to be pleased or to condescend' 11. अस् 'to be'.

3.4.66.e: The affix तुमुन् comes after a verb having in composition with it अलम् and its synonyms when these words express to be capable of something.

3.4.67.e: The affixes called कृत् are used in the sense of an agent.

3.4.68.e: The words 1. भव्य 2. गेय 3. प्रवचनीय 3. उपस्थानीय 4. जन्य 5. आप्लाव्य 6. आपात्य may be optionally be used to denote the agent.

3.4.69.a: लः कर्तरि कर्मणि च, भावे कर्तरि  च अकर्मकेभ्यः धातोः परश्च
3.4.69.e: For the सकर्मक verb roots, the लकार can be used in the कर्तरि as well as the कर्मणि sense. For the अकर्मक verb roots, the लकार can be used in कर्तरि as well as भावे sense.

3.4.70.e: The affixes called कृत्य and the affix called क्त and those that have the sense of खल् have only these last two senses, viz. an action and an object (भाव and कर्म).

3.4.71.e: The affix क्त also denotes the agent when it expresses a beginning of an action.

3.4.72.e: The affix क्त is used in denoting the agent as well as the act and the object after verbs implying motion after intransitive roots and after the verbs 1. श्लिष् 'to embrace' 2. शि 'to lie down' 3. स्था 'to stand' 4. आस् 'to sit' 5. वस् 'to dwell' 6. जन् 'to produce' 7. रुह् 'to mount' 8. जृ 'to grow old'.

3.4.73.e: The word दाश and गोघ्न are irregularly formed and the affix in these denotes the idea of the Dative or Recipient.

3.4.74.e: The words भीम etc. are irregularly formed and denote ablation.

3.4.75.e: The words formed by उणादि affixes denote other ideas other than these two - 1. Reciepient 2. Ablation.

3.4.76.e: The affix क्त which is ordained after roots denoting fixedness (to cling to a place), motion and taking gives the sense of location as well.

3.4.77.e: All the आदेशs mentioned in this अधिकार happen in place of  लकारs.

3.4.78.e: A लकार is initially converted to one of these 18 आदेशाः - तिप्, तस्, झि, सिप्, थस्, थ, मिप्, वस्, मस्, त, आताम्, झ, थास्, आथाम्, ध्वम्, इड्, वहि, महिङ्.

3.4.79.e: In case of टित्-लकारs, the 'टि' of the आत्मनेपद प्रत्ययs is converted to 'ए'.

3.4.80.e: In case of टित्-लकारs, the आत्मनेपद प्रत्यय थास् is converted to 'से'.

3.4.81.e: In case of आत्मनेपद of लिट्-लकार, the त-प्रत्यय is converted to एश् and  झ प्रत्यय is converted to इरेच्.

3.4.82.e: In case of the लिट् लकार, the परस्मैपद प्रत्ययाः are respectively converted to - णल्,अतुस्, उस्, थल्, अथुस्, अ, णल्, व, म.

3.4.83.a: विदः लिटः लस्य परस्मैपदानाम् णल्-अतुस्-उस्-थल्-अथुस्-अ-णल्-व-माः वा
3.4.83.e: For the verb विद्, the प्रत्ययाः of लिट्लकार are optionally converted (respectively) to णल्,अतुस्, उस्, थल्, अथुस्, अ, णल्, व, म.

3.4.84.a: ब्रुवः लटः लस्य परस्मैपदानामादितः पञ्चानाम् णल्-अतुस्-उस्-थल्-अथुस् , ब्रुवः आहः ।
3.4.84.e: In case of the verb ब्रू, the first five परस्मैपद-प्रत्ययाः of लट्लकार are converted optionally to (respectively) णल्, अतुस्, उस्, थल्, and अथुस्. Also, when this happens, the verb 'ब्रू' is converted to 'आह्'.

3.4.85.e: The प्रत्ययाः of the लोट्-लकार are derived in the same way as that of the लङ्लकार.

3.4.86.e: The इकार present in the  प्रत्ययाs of लोट्लकार is converted to उकार.

3.4.87.a: लोटः लस्य सेः हि अपित् च
3.4.87.e: The सिप्-प्रत्यय of the लोट्-लकार is converted to 'हि'.

3.4.88.a: लोटः लस्य सेः हि छन्दसि वा अपित् च
3.4.88.e: In the context of वेदाः, the 'हि' आदेश given to the सिप्-प्रत्यय of लोट्-लकार could be seen considered as पित्.

3.4.89.e: In the context of लोट्लकार, the मिप् प्रत्यय is converted to नि.

3.4.90.e: An एकार present in the प्रत्ययाः of लोट्-लकार is converted to आम्.

3.4.91.e: An एकार coming after a  सकार  or a  वकार of प्रत्यय of लोट्लकार is respectively converted to व and अम्.

3.4.92.a: लोटः लस्य उत्तमस्य आट् पित् च
3.4.92.e: The उत्तमपुरुष प्रत्ययाः of लोट्-लकार get the आट्-आगम, and this आगम is considered पित्.

3.4.93.e: The एकार occurring in the उत्तमपुरुष प्रत्ययाः of लोट्-लकार is converted to ऐ.

3.4.94.e: The augments अट् and आट् are added to the तिङ् (Personal Endings) of the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive).

3.4.95.e: In the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive) ऐ is the substitute of आ in the first and second person dual of the आत्मनेपद ।

3.4.96.e: In the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive) ऐ is optionally the substitute of ए in other places then those mentioned in the last sūtra.

3.4.97.e: In the परस्मैपद affixes the इ is optionally elided in the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive).

3.4.98.e: The स् of the first person is optionally elided in the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive).

3.4.99.a: ङितः लस्य उत्तमस्य सः नित्यं लोपः
3.4.99.e: In case of ङित् लकारs, the ending सकार of the प्रत्ययाः of उत्तमपुरुष is removed.

3.4.100.e: In case of ङित् लकारs, The इकार present in the परस्मैपद-प्रत्ययs is removed.

3.4.101.e: In case of ङित्-लकारs, तस्, थस्, थ and मिप् are converted respectively to  ताम्, तम्, त and अम्.

3.4.102.e: The तिङ् (Personal Endings) of the लिङ् (Benedictive) and the Potential take the augment स्युत् ।

3.4.103.a: लिङः परस्मैपदेषु यासुट् उदात्तः ङित् च
3.4.103.e: The परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्ययाः of लिङ्लकार get a 'यासुट्' आगम which is both - उदात्त and ङित्.

3.4.104.a: आशिषि लिङः परस्मैपदेषु यासुट् उदात्तः कित्
3.4.104.e: The परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्ययाः of आशीर्लिङ्लकार get a 'यासुट्' आगम which is both - उदात्त and कित्.

3.4.105.e: The झ-प्रत्यय of लिङ्लकार is converted to रन्.

3.4.106.e: The इट्-प्रत्यय of लिङ्लकार is converted to 'अ'.

3.4.107.e: In case of लिङ्लकार, the तकार and थकार present in the प्रत्ययाः get the 'सुट्' आगम.

3.4.108.e: The 'झि' प्रत्यय of लिङ्लकार is converted to 'जुस्'.

3.4.109.e: The झि-प्रत्यय of a ङित्-लकार that follows सिच्, अभ्यस्त or the verb root विद् is converted  to जुस्.

3.4.110.e: For an आकारान्त अङ्ग, even  when the सिच् प्रत्यय is removed, the झि-प्रत्यय of a ङित्-लकार is converted to जुस्.

3.4.111.e: In the opinion of शाकटायन only जुस् is the substitute of झि , in the लङ् (Imperfect Tense) of the roots which end in a long आ।

3.4.112.e: In the opinion of शाकटायन only जुस् is the substitute of झि , in the लङ् (Imperfect Tense) after the verb द्विष् 'to hate'.

3.4.113.e: The तिङ् प्रत्ययs and the शित् प्रत्ययs are called 'सार्वधातुक'.

3.4.114.e: Except for तिङ् and शित् प्रत्ययs, other प्रत्ययs that are attached to verbs are called 'आर्धधातुक'.

3.4.115.e: The तिङ्-प्रत्ययs of the लिट्-लकार get the term आर्धधातुक.

3.4.116.e: The प्रत्ययs of आशीर्लिङ्-लकार are termed आर्धधातुक.

3.4.117.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) this distinction of सार्वधातुक and आर्द्धधातुक is not always maintained and the affixes are promiscuously used.
